verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its Data Access API as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON document on SwaggerHub, available at a direct swagger.json URL. The SmartBear developer portal hosts a reference generated from that spec, with pages on authentication, pagination, rate limiting and versioning. The probe 404s only show the spec is not at conventional paths on docs.bugsnag.com; they do not contradict the SwaggerHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: discoverability of the spec at well-known paths on the docs domain, independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.
